_comment_die: boot_mem_top_gf180's cell area is tiny (~85 instances) but, like mem_region_mux, its port list is the flattened cpu_instruction_o_t/i_t + cpu_data_o_t/i_t record buses -- 155 IO pins. Force an explicit absolute die just large enough for the pin count -- NOT for any macro (there is none) -- matching mem_region_mux/config.json's rationale for the same class of problem.
